name: unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self
rule: `Weak::from_raw_in(ptr, alloc)` takes ownership of the weak reference represented by `ptr` without modifying the weak count, except that pointers created by `Weak::new` own nothing.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::sync::Weak < T , A > { unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self }
